record.title: JST B3B-EH-A — 3-circuit EH 2.5 mm pitch top-entry Type A board header (the DYNAMIXEL X-series TTL socket, ROBOTIS e-Manual 'PCB Header JST B3B-EH-A')
record.origin_why: Every dimension was read off JST's own EH CONNECTOR datasheet eEH.pdf p.4 'Header/ Type A' (fetched jst-mfg.com 2026-09-04, sha256 9e35874b…, vendored at iterations/v0.0.1/docs/fetched/eEH.pdf) and every electrical figure off its p.1 Specifications block; the part number itself comes from ROBOTIS' e-Manual XL330-M288-T §Connector Information ('PCB Header JST B3B-EH-A'). `standard` would be wrong: no published standard fixes an EH. `measured` would be wrong: no instrument has touched one here — the KiCad STEP corroboration is a measurement of a model, not of a part.
record.lifecycle_why: eEH.pdf carries no lifecycle statement and no distributor page was fetched for this member (the workshop family folder part:conn-jst-eh-2.5mm holds an offer for the 4-circuit member only).
record.why: ENVELOPE, PIN ROW AND MATED HEIGHT ARE VENDOR-DRAWN AND BUILD: cad/part.py constructs 10.0000 x 3.8000 x 6.0000 above the board with three □0.64 posts at x -2.5000 / 0.0000 / +2.5000 from 3.2 below to 4.2 above the board, and the built solid's bbox reproduces the KiCad B3B-EH-A body's 10.0 x 3.8 x 9.2 exactly (measured 2026-09-04). What keeps this CANNOT DETERMINE rather than PASS: (1) the wafer's internal detail — latch relief, polarising rib, back wall — is simplified to a 9.5 x 3.8 x 5.1 cavity, so the built volume is NOT the vendor body's (the KiCad model reads 97.0168 mm3; ours is whatever the ledger's build row says) and a clearance check against a housing would be against an envelope; (2) mass is CANNOT DETERMINE — eEH.pdf states none and cecad's NYLON density (1.14 g/cm3) applied to a simplified volume is not a vendor mass; (3) no offer has been fetched for THIS member. What settles it: a vendor STEP with the internal detail (or calipers on the part), a mass on a scale, and a distributor page.

where_on_the_microduck.xl330_m288_t: one socket on each side face of every XL330 — 15 servos x 2 = 30 headers inside the actuators, bought inside the servo, not separately (ROBOTIS e-Manual §Connector Information). part:xl330-m288-t/cad/interfaces.json 'dxl_socket_pos_y'/'dxl_socket_neg_y' carry the measured pocket frames.
where_on_the_microduck.robot_hat: the HAT's bus port(s): part:microduck-robot-hat-pcb interface 'peripheral_connectors' block B is 2 columns x 3 holes on a 2.5000 mm pitch, phi 0.9500 — the EH drill (phi0.9 +0.1/0, p.2) at the EH pitch — so two B3B-EH-A fit that pattern. WHICH of the two is the DYNAMIXEL port is CANNOT DETERMINE from a mesh with no silkscreen (that folder says so); electronics/robot-hat/board.py is the design that decides it.
where_on_the_microduck.imu_to_dxl: 2 or 3 headers depending on option A/B/C in part:microduck-imu-to-dxl record.connector_count — CANNOT DETERMINE.
